header.function_name: XD01 Cross Dock Part Master Screen

revisions.author: FID Rayhan
revisions.description: Initial Draft: business version of UISS XD01_UISS_Screen_CrossDockPartMaster.xlsx

objective: Give Procurement and the D/S team one place to manage which parts are handled by crossdock and how many cases per day go to each destination, and to send this master to GTOPAS and AP POLE.
One screen with two tabs: Part List (part number level) and Mapping per Destination (part + calculation period + destination level).
Part List tab: To register crossdock candidate parts (Part No, Min MAD, Pcs/Case, Max Case/Day, Effective Start Date).
Part List tab: To search and display registered crossdock parts with their status and capacity.
Part List tab: To change part data and part status (Candidate / Active / Inactive) of a registered part.
Part List tab: To display the change history of a part.
Part List tab: To export the Part List to Excel and upload part settings from Excel (Add and Edit).
Part List tab: This sub-menu is opened only for users logged in with a Procurement account; users with a D/S account open the Mapping per Destination sub-menu instead.
Mapping per Destination tab: To split the Max Case/Day of each Active part over destinations (Thailand, Philippines, Vietnam) for the ongoing calculation period.
Mapping per Destination tab: To display the destination mapping per part and calculation period, including past periods (read only).
Mapping per Destination tab: To start the interfaces of the cross dock master to GTOPAS (XD06) and AP POLE (XD07) for changed parts, and show the Sync Status of each part.
Mapping per Destination tab: To export the mapping to Excel and upload the mapping of the ongoing period from Excel.
Mapping per Destination tab: This sub-menu is opened only for users logged in with a D/S account; users with a Procurement account open the Part List sub-menu instead.

buttons.name: Tab (Part List / Mapping per Destination)
buttons.function: Switch between the Part List tab and the Mapping per Destination tab.

buttons.name: Add Part
buttons.function: Open the "Add Part Candidate Crossdock" modal (Add Mode), ready to register a new part.

buttons.name: Upload Excel (Part List)
buttons.function: Open the "Upload Excel - part settings" modal (Upload Mode).

buttons.name: Export Excel (Part List)
buttons.function: Download the Part List as .xlsx: sheet "Part List" (active filter) and sheet "Upload" (base file for Edit uploads).

buttons.name: Run calculation (Part List)
buttons.function: Start the DAD Volume Calculation batch manually. Enabled only when the scheduled run and its 3 auto retries have failed.

buttons.name: Reset
buttons.function: Clear criteria and reset the screen to its initial value.

buttons.name: Search
buttons.function: To retrieve records according to the specified criteria. The criteria are applied only when [Search] is clicked (or Enter is pressed in a text box); Sort by is applied at once.

buttons.name: Part Number link / Edit
buttons.function: Change the screen into edit mode to modify the selected row ("Edit part data" modal).

buttons.name: History
buttons.function: Open the "History setting" modal of the selected part.

buttons.name: Prev / Next
buttons.function: Move to the previous / next page of the result list.

buttons.name: Save
buttons.function: Part List tab: Save the part data entered in the Add / Edit modal.; Mapping per Destination tab: Save the destination mapping of the part.

buttons.name: Cancel
buttons.function: Part List tab: Close the Add / Edit modal without saving.; Mapping per Destination tab: Leave edit mode and discard all changes of the panel.

buttons.name: Close
buttons.function: Part List tab: Close the History setting / Upload Excel modal (also the X icon of every modal).; Mapping per Destination tab: Close the Upload Excel modal without uploading.

buttons.name: Validate file
buttons.function: Save button of the upload: validate the uploaded file and save it (all-or-nothing), then show the success popup.

buttons.name: OK
buttons.function: Close the success popup.

buttons.name: Run calculation (Mapping)
buttons.function: Start process 2 (mapping destination) of the XD05 DAD Volume Calculation batch manually. Enabled only when the scheduled run and its 3 auto retries have failed.

buttons.name: Sync
buttons.function: Start XD06 (GTOPAS) and XD07 (AP POLE) for every Active part of the ongoing period, and every part that became Inactive, with Sync Status No Sync or Failed, whatever the filter shows; the parts become Waiting. The label shows the number of parts, e.g. Sync (9).

buttons.name: Upload Excel (Mapping)
buttons.function: Open the "Upload Excel - destination mapping" modal. Enabled only when the ongoing calculation period is selected.

buttons.name: Export Excel (Mapping)
buttons.function: Download the mapping as .xlsx: sheet "Mapping per Destination" (active filter) and sheet "Upload" (base file for the upload).

buttons.name: Expand (arrow)
buttons.function: Open / close the Destination Mapping panel of the part row.

buttons.name: Edit mapping
buttons.function: Change the Destination Mapping panel into edit mode (ongoing period only).

buttons.name: Split evenly
buttons.function: Divide Max Case/Day evenly over all destinations of the part.

buttons.name: Add destination
buttons.function: Add a new destination row (destination not selected, Case/Day 0).

buttons.name: Remove destination
buttons.function: Remove the destination row (trash icon).

screen_mode_remarks: 1) Prev is disabled on the first page and Next on the last page.
2) A user logged in with a read-only account sees [View] instead of [Edit] and cannot use Add Part / Upload Excel / Save. TBD: which accounts are read-only is not defined yet.
3) Run calculation is shown as D (disabled) by default; it is enabled only when the scheduled DAD Volume Calculation has failed 3 times (auto retry).
4) Sync is enabled only when at least one Active part of the ongoing period, or a part that became Inactive, is No Sync or Failed (not limited to the listed rows).
5) Split evenly is shown only in edit mode when the part has more than one destination row.
7) Prev is disabled on the first page and Next on the last page.
8) Run calculation is enabled only when the scheduled XD05 DAD Volume Calculation (process 2) has failed 3 times (auto retry); otherwise disabled with message no. 30 as tooltip.
6) A user logged in with a read-only account cannot use Edit mapping, Sync or Upload Excel. TBD: which accounts are read-only is not defined yet.
9) '-' = the button is not on the tab of the mode.

rows: A new part always starts as Candidate. Active / Inactive is decided by the monthly calculation: average MAD of the last months ≥ Min MAD → Active, otherwise Inactive.
The user may change Active ↔ Inactive, but a part can never go back to Candidate.
Default is tomorrow, it cannot be in the past, and it can only be changed while the part is Candidate. A part is calculated only from its Effective Start Date.
The total case/day of all destinations must not exceed the Max Case/Day of the part. A lower total is allowed and shown as "n case/day left".
Max Case/Day cannot be reduced below the case/day already mapped; the mapping has to be reduced first.
A destination appears only once per part and must exist in the destination master (GTOPAS).
Each monthly calculation creates a new period that starts from the calculated proposal; previous periods are kept view-only.
Any change to a part or its mapping (screen or upload) marks the part "Not yet sent".
One Sync sends every Active part that is not yet sent or failed, plus the parts that became Inactive (sent as "stop crossdock").
A part is "Sent" only when both GTOPAS and AP POLE received it. If one target fails, the part is "Failed" with the reason; if it is changed while sending, it goes back to "Not yet sent".
An Excel upload is saved only when the whole file is valid; otherwise nothing is saved and the user gets a report with the rows to correct.
Every change is kept in the history for 24 months.

operation.text: 5.1 - 5.10: Part List tab. 5.11 - 5.20: Mapping per Destination tab.

items: The sub-menu is opened only for users logged in with a Procurement account.
Search criteria: 'Part Number' and 'Part Name' blank, 'Status' = All, 'Sort by' = Newer to Older.
Show all parts of the Part List sorted by last update time, newest first, 25 rows per page, page 1.
If no part is registered at all, hide the table and display message no. 2 with [Upload Excel] and [Add one part].
The criteria are applied when the user clicks [Search] (or presses Enter in 'Part Number' / 'Part Name'); changing a criterion alone does not change the list. 'Sort by' is applied at once.
'Part Number' and 'Part Name' match by 'contains', case-insensitive; 'Status' matches exactly. All criteria are combined with AND.
Clicking [Search] or changing 'Sort by' or 'Rows per page' returns the list to page 1.
If no row matches, hide the table and paging and display message no. 1 with [Reset filter].
Counter 'N parts' is counted over the whole filtered result, not only the current page.
Total Pcs/Day = Pcs/Case x Max Case/Day.
Open the 'Add Part Candidate Crossdock' modal. 'Status' = Candidate and locked (a new part is always Candidate); 'Effective Start Date' = system date + 1 day, minimum today.
'Part No' lists the parts of the Part Master that are not yet in the Part List (a part can be registered only once).
Selecting a Part No autofills 'Part Name'. 'Max Case/Day' is locked until 'Pcs/Case' is filled.

[Save] is enabled only when Part No, Min MAD (whole number, 0 or more), Pcs/Case > 0 and Max Case/Day > 0 are filled; otherwise its tooltip shows message no. 5, 15, 6 or 7 for the first missing item. Effective Start Date
If the Part No was registered by another user in the meantime, display message no. 3. Stop.
Save the part in the Part List with status = Candidate and Sync Status = No Sync (see Data Edit Mapping).
Record the change in the change history.
Close the modal, reset the Part Number / Part Name / Status filters, sort Newer to Older and display message no. 9. The new part is shown at the top.

operation.text: User clicks [Cancel] or the X icon: close the modal without saving.
User clicks the 'Part Number' link or [Edit] on a row.

items: Open the 'Edit part data' modal with the saved values. 'Part No' is locked; 'Status' can be Candidate / Active / Inactive.
'Effective Start Date' is editable only while the saved status is Candidate (minimum today); otherwise locked with message no. 10 as tooltip.
'Min MAD' (mandatory, whole number 0 or more), 'Pcs/Case' and 'Max Case/Day' can be changed; 'Total Pcs/Day' is recalculated.

Below Max Case/Day show 'Mapped Case/Day (current period): n' = total Case/Day of the part in destination mapping for the ongoing period (' · no destination yet' when none), so the user sees the lowest allowed Max Case/Day before Save.

Max Case/Day can not be less than the total Case/Day already mapped to destinations in the ongoing period (destination mapping); otherwise the field is marked red, message no. 14 is shown below Pcs/Case & Max Case/Day and [Save] is disabled. The user must first reduce the mapping in Mapping per Destination (same rule as upload check 9).
If the record was changed by another user after it was opened, display message no. 4. Stop.
Check again that Max Case/Day is not below the mapped total of the ongoing period; if it is, display message no. 14. Stop.
Save the changes in the Part List and set Sync Status = No Sync, updated by and last update time. Every Save returns the part to No Sync so the D/S user synchronises it again.
Record the change in the change history.
Close the modal, move the part to the top of the list and display message no. 9.
The history shows every change made to the part.
User clicks the clock icon on a row: open 'History setting' with the change timeline of the part, newest first.
Each event shows the title, date-time, field name, old value (struck through) → new value and user.
The history records every change of the part: Add / Edit by screen, Upload, mapping changes (add, change or remove a destination) and Sync results. A part without history shows message no. 12.

operation.text: The history is kept for 24 months (to be confirmed).

items: User clicks [Upload Excel]: open the modal with the template columns, the rules and the file area (.xlsx, max 5 MB, max 5,000 rows).
Edit rows use sheet 'Upload' of the Part List Export Excel as base file (pre-filled with upload = E).
Status rule: a Candidate part's status cannot be changed by upload; Active <-> Inactive can be changed; no part can be changed to Candidate.

User clicks [Validate file] (save button of the upload): the file is passed to the upload batch; validation, saving (all-or-nothing) and logging follow UISS-Batch "XD02 Cross Dock Part Master Upload Batch".
When the upload is completed, close the modal and display message no. 11. When it is rejected, show the batch result (error list) - refer UISS-Batch.
Changed parts show Sync Status No Sync.
User clicks [Export Excel]: download Crossdock_Part_List_YYYYMMDD.xlsx.

Sheet 'Part List': rows of the active filter and sort (all pages) with Part Number, Part Name, Min MAD, Pcs/Case, Max Case/Day, Total Pcs/Day, Status, Effective Start Date, Last Update. Information only.
Sheet 'Upload': every registered part with part_no, min_mad, pcs_case, max_case_day, status, upload = E, effective_start_date (DD-Mon-YYYY). Base file for Edit uploads.
If the file cannot be created, display message no. 13.

The DAD Volume Calculation batch runs on its own scheduler (set in system master) with 3 auto retries. It compares the average MAD of each part with Min MAD and sets the part status to Active or Inactive (refer UISS-Batch XD05 DAD Volume Calculation (process 1)).
The result list header shows 'Last DAD calculation' (last successful run) and, when the scheduled run and its 3 retries have failed, the badge 'Scheduled run failed 3x'.
[Run calculation] is enabled only in that failed state; otherwise it is disabled with message no. 17 as tooltip.

User clicks [Run calculation]: start the batch. When it completes, update 'Last DAD calculation', hide the badge, refresh the list and display message no. 16. When it fails, the batch logs the error (all-or-nothing) and the button stays enabled.

A change from Active to Inactive made by the batch sets the part to No Sync (it is sent as inactive by the next [Sync]); other status changes made by the batch do not change the Sync Status. The user may still change the status afterwards by screen or upload.

rows: Newly registered part without MAD history. Initial status of every new part; cannot be chosen when adding.
Active part. Only Active parts can be mapped in the Mapping per Destination sub-menu.
Inactive part. Not mapped in the Mapping per Destination sub-menu.
Not sent yet, or changed since the last synchronisation. Set on every Save.
[Sync] clicked in the Mapping per Destination tab; waiting for XD06 (GTOPAS) and / or XD07 (AP POLE).
Both XD06 (GTOPAS) and XD07 (AP POLE) sent Pcs/Case, Max Case/Day and the destination mapping of the ongoing period.
XD06 or XD07 could not send the part (target and reason in sync message); sent again by the next [Sync].

operation.text: Only Active parts are synchronised. A Save while the part is Waiting returns it to No Sync, so the result of XD06 / XD07 for the old data is not kept as Success.

items: The sub-menu is opened only for users logged in with a D/S account.
Search criteria: 'Calculation period' = ongoing period, 'Part Number' blank, 'Sync Status' = No Sync.
Ongoing period: list every Active part of Part List, with its destinations of destination mapping for that period (a part without destinations is listed with Total Case/Day 0).

A new period starts empty: the mapping of the previous period is not copied. Every Active part is listed with its Max Case/Day from Part List (the quota) but no destination yet (Total Case/Day 0, 0%), until the D/S user assigns it by Edit mapping or Upload Excel.
Past period: list every part that has rows in destination mapping for that period, whatever its current status. 'All periods' lists both.
The criteria are applied when the user clicks [Search] (or presses Enter in 'Part Number'); changing a criterion alone does not change the list.
'Part Number' matches by 'contains', case-insensitive; 'Calculation period' and 'Sync Status' match exactly. All criteria are combined with AND.
[Upload Excel] and Export Excel follow the period of the applied criteria.
If no row matches, hide the table and display message no. 18.
With the default Sync Status = No Sync, parts that are Success or Failed are hidden until the filter is changed.
Total Case/Day = sum of Case/Day of the part and period; Pcs/Day = Pcs/Case x Total Case/Day.
Percentage = Total Case/Day / Max Case/Day; it never exceeds 100% because the total can not go above Max Case/Day (Save, upload and the Max Case/Day edit in Part List are blocked).

The list is paged: 25 rows per page by default (25 / 50 / 100), with paging information and [Prev] / [Next]. A part with its Destination Mapping panel counts as one row. [Search], Reset and a change of Rows per page return to page 1.
User clicks the arrow on a row: open the panel with the allocation chip, the note and the destination table (Destination, Case/Day, Pcs/Day, Percentage). All items are read only.
Ongoing period: show [Edit mapping]. Past period: show message no. 22 instead; the mapping cannot be changed.
A part without destination shows message no. 19.
Copy the mapping into a draft; Destination and Case/Day become editable, a trash icon appears per row and [Add destination] is shown.
The Destination list hides destinations already used by another row of the same part (one destination per part).
[Add destination] adds a row with 'Select destination' and Case/Day 0.
[Split evenly] (more than one row): Case/Day of each row = floor(Max Case/Day / number of rows); the remainder is added +1 per row from the first row. Example 24 / 3 = 8 / 8 / 8; 25 / 3 = 9 / 8 / 8.
The allocation chip and note are recalculated on every change.
the total Case/Day is above Max Case/Day (show message no. 20);
the part has no destination row; or
a row has no destination selected (show message no. 21).
A total below or equal to Max Case/Day is allowed; below is shown as '{n} case/day left'.
If the mapping was changed by another user after edit mode started, display message no. 25. Stop.
Save the new destination mapping of the part for the ongoing period (see Data Edit Mapping).
Set Sync Status = No Sync in Part List, so the D/S user synchronises the part again.
Record every added, changed or removed destination in the change history (old and new Case/Day).
Leave edit mode and show the saved mapping.

operation.text: User clicks [Cancel] or closes the panel: discard the draft.

items: Select every Active part of the ongoing period, and every part that became Inactive (set to No Sync by XD05), with Sync Status No Sync or Failed, whatever the search criteria show (n of the button). Inactive parts are sent with crossdock flag (Y / N) 'N' so GTOPAS and AP POLE change their status to inactive. Candidate parts are never synchronised.

Set Sync Status = Waiting for these parts in Part List, set one row per part and target system (GTOPAS, AP POLE) to sending status = Waiting in sending result, and start XD06 and XD07. Display message no. 27.
With the default filter No Sync the parts leave the list; select Sync Status = Waiting or All to follow them.

operation.text: Interface functions (one per target system; refer UISS-Batch XD06 and XD07).

items: XD06 IF Cross Dock Master to GTOPAS and XD07 IF Cross Dock Master to AP POLE each send, per Waiting part, Pcs/Case and Max Case/Day (Part List) and all destinations with Case/Day of the ongoing period (destination mapping) as one complete set.
Each function creates an interface file and sends it by SFTP to its target; the result (sent or failed, with the reason) is kept per target system.

Overall Sync Status of the part: stays Waiting while one target is still Waiting; Success when both targets are Success; Failed when a target failed (sync message = target and reason); No Sync when the part was changed after it was read.
Every result is recorded in change history (event SYNC, source IF, remark = target and message).

operation.text: A Failed part shows sync message (target and reason) as tooltip on its chip (message no. 28) and is sent again to both targets by the next [Sync] (replace is repeatable).
Interface method: file by SFTP to GTOPAS (XD06) and AP POLE (XD07); fields and topology refer UISS-Batch XD06 / XD07 (topology TBC).

items: [Upload Excel] is enabled only when the ongoing calculation period is selected; otherwise it is disabled with message no. 23 as tooltip.
The modal shows the template columns (part_no, dest_code, case_day, upload, total_case_day), the upload rules and the file area (.xlsx, max 5 MB, max 5,000 rows).
Base file: sheet 'Upload' of Export Excel with the ongoing period selected. A part in the file gets its whole mapping replaced; parts not in the file are not changed.

User clicks [Validate file] (save button of the upload): the file is passed to the upload batch; validation, saving (all-or-nothing) and logging follow UISS-Batch "XD03 Part and Destination Mapping Upload Batch".
When the upload is completed, close the modal and display message no. 24. When it is rejected, show the batch result (error list) - refer UISS-Batch.
Changed parts show Sync Status No Sync.
User clicks [Export Excel]: download Crossdock_Mapping_per_Destination_<period>_YYYYMMDD.xlsx (<period> e.g. Sep_2026 or All_periods).

Sheet 'Mapping per Destination': rows of the active filter, one row per destination (a part without destination gives one row with blank destination columns). Columns: Period, Part Number, Part Name, Pcs/Case, Total Case/Day, Pcs/Day, Percentage, Sync Status, Destination Code, Destination, Dest Case/Day, Dest Pcs/Day, Dest Percentage. Information only.

Sheet 'Upload': every Active part of the ongoing period with part_no, dest_code, case_day, upload, total_case_day (= Max Case/Day); one row per destination, and one row with dest_code and case_day blank for a part without mapping. Empty when a past period or All periods is selected. upload = E for a mapped destination, A for the blank row.
If the file cannot be created, display message no. 26.

The XD05 process 2 (mapping destination) batch runs on its own scheduler (set in system master) with 3 auto retries. It creates the new calculation period and its destination mapping (refer UISS-Batch XD05 DAD Volume Calculation (process 2)).
The section header shows 'Last mapping calculation' (last successful run) and, when the scheduled run and its 3 retries have failed, the badge 'Scheduled run failed 3x'.
[Run calculation] is enabled only in that failed state; otherwise it is disabled with message no. 30 as tooltip.

User clicks [Run calculation]: start the batch. When it completes, update 'Last mapping calculation', hide the badge and display message no. 29. When it fails, the batch logs the error (all-or-nothing) and the button stays enabled.

rows: Part List data, part number level (key Part No). Holds Max Case/Day, status and Sync Status.
Mapping data, part number + calculation period + destination level (key Part No, period, destination code). period = CHAR(6) YYYYMM, e.g. 202609; displayed as 'Sep 2026'.
Destination Master (existing, read only). Crossdock uses destination code and destination name only.
Only Active parts are mapped in the ongoing period.
Not sent yet, or changed since the last synchronisation.
[Sync] clicked; waiting for XD06 (GTOPAS) and / or XD07 (AP POLE).
The part was sent to GTOPAS and AP POLE.
GTOPAS or AP POLE could not receive the part; target and reason in sync message; retried by the next [Sync].
Created by the calculation batch. Ongoing (latest period): mapping can be edited and uploaded. Past: read only.

operation.text: Sync Status is kept per part in Part List because a part is sent as one set (Pcs/Case, Max Case/Day and all destinations); the result per target system is in sending result. Every mapping change and every Sync result is recorded in change history (with the period).

rows: Given a new part, when Procurement saves it, then its status is Candidate and the Effective Start Date is tomorrow unless changed.
Given an Active part, when Procurement opens Edit, then the Effective Start Date is locked and the status can only be Active or Inactive.
Given Max Case/Day 24 and destinations totalling 24, when D/S adds 1 case/day to a destination, then Save is blocked with the over-capacity message.
Given a part with 20 case/day mapped, when Procurement changes Max Case/Day to 18, then Save is blocked until the mapping is reduced.
Given 3 changed Active parts and 1 part that became Inactive, when D/S clicks Sync, then 4 parts are sent and the Inactive part is sent as "stop crossdock".
Given GTOPAS receives a part and AP POLE fails, when the sending ends, then the part is Failed with the AP POLE reason.
Given an upload file with 1 invalid row out of 100, when validated, then nothing is saved and the report lists that row.
Given the scheduled calculation failed 3 times, when the user clicks Run calculation, then the calculation runs and the last success date is updated.
